translations.zh: 这个故事讲的是一位善良的国王。

senses.definition: a short piece of information you send or leave for someone

examples.text: I sent you a message.

senses.definition: new, or of the present time

examples.text: They live in a modern building.

translations.zh: 他们住在一栋现代化的大楼里。

senses.definition: the direction that is on your left when you face the rising sun

examples.text: They live in the north of China.

senses.definition: a thick liquid used for cooking, or for machines and fuel

examples.text: Add some oil to the pan.

senses.definition: a mother or a father

examples.text: My parents live in a small town.

translations.zh: 我父母住在一个小镇上。

senses.definition: a living thing that grows in the ground, with leaves and roots

examples.text: Don't forget to water the plants.

senses.definition: to put seeds or young plants in the ground to grow

examples.text: We planted a tree in the garden.

translations.zh: 我们在花园里种了一棵树。

senses.definition: having very little money

examples.text: They were poor, but they were happy.

senses.definition: used to show you feel sorry for someone

examples.text: Poor Anna! She lost her cat.

translations.zh: 可怜的安娜！她的猫丢了。

senses.definition: doing something again and again to get better at it

examples.text: Speaking a language needs a lot of practice.

translations.zh: 说一门语言需要大量练习。

senses.usageNote: In British English 'practice' is the noun and 'practise' is the verb: 'I need more practice, so I practise every day.'

senses.definition: one of the four parts of the year: spring, summer, autumn and winter

examples.text: Which season do you like best?

senses.definition: easy to understand or do

examples.text: The rules of the game are simple.

translations.zh: 这个游戏的规则很简单。

senses.definition: the direction on your right when you face the rising sun

examples.text: They live in the south of France.

senses.definition: the warmest season of the year, between spring and autumn

examples.text: We go to the beach every summer.

translations.zh: 我们每年夏天都去海边。

senses.definition: to help someone learn something

examples.text: My mum teaches maths.
Dad taught me to ride a bike.
examples.cloze: Dad {{taught}} me to ride a bike.

senses.definition: a machine with a screen that shows programmes; also called TV

examples.text: What's on television tonight?

translations.zh: 今晚电视上有什么节目？

senses.usageNote: Say 'watch television' or 'on television', not 'see television' or 'in television'.

senses.definition: the number 1,000

examples.text: The school has two thousand students.

translations.zh: 这所学校有两千名学生。

senses.usageNote: After a number, don't add -s: 'two thousand', not 'two thousands'. Also, English has no word for 万: 10,000 is 'ten thousand'.

senses.definition: a tall plant with a wooden trunk, branches and leaves

examples.text: There's a bird in the tree.

senses.definition: the direction where the sun goes down

examples.text: The sun sets in the west.

senses.definition: a person whose job is to teach

examples.text: Our maths teacher is very patient.

translations.zh: 我们的数学老师很有耐心。

senses.definition: coming at the end; last

examples.text: This is the final question.

senses.definition: the last game in a competition, which decides the winner

examples.text: Our team is in the final!

senses.definition: a thing with moving parts that uses power to do a job

examples.text: Put your clothes in the washing machine.

translations.zh: 把你的衣服放进洗衣机。

senses.definition: usual or ordinary; what you expect

examples.text: It was a normal school day.

translations.zh: 那是一个平常的上学日。

senses.definition: a large public area with grass and trees where people can walk and play

examples.text: The children are playing in the park.

senses.definition: to stop a car and leave it somewhere

examples.text: You can park in front of the shop.

translations.zh: 你可以把车停在商店前面。

senses.definition: the large area of salty water that covers much of the earth

examples.text: We swam in the sea every day.

translations.zh: 我们每天都在海里游泳。

senses.definition: something you do for fun or to learn

examples.text: Swimming is my favourite activity.

translations.zh: 游泳是我最喜欢的活动。

senses.definition: one of the two long parts of your body between your shoulder and your hand

examples.text: She hurt her arm playing tennis.

senses.definition: to take hold of something that is moving through the air

examples.text: Catch the ball!

senses.definition: to get on a bus, train or plane

examples.text: I need to catch the 8 o'clock bus.

senses.definition: a person's female child

examples.text: They have two daughters.

senses.definition: going a long way down from the top

examples.text: The pool is very deep here.

senses.definition: to make a picture with a pen or pencil

examples.text: Can you draw a horse?

senses.definition: the planet we live on

examples.text: The Earth goes around the Sun.

senses.definition: the direction where the sun comes up in the morning

examples.text: The sun rises in the east.

senses.definition: every person

examples.text: Everybody likes her.

senses.definition: from or in a country that is not your own

examples.text: Can you speak a foreign language?

senses.usageNote: Calling a person 'a foreigner' can sound unfriendly. 'Visitor' or 'people from other countries' is kinder.

senses.definition: having a high temperature

examples.text: It's very hot today.

senses.definition: having a strong, burning taste

examples.text: This soup is too hot for me.

senses.definition: in or into a room, building or container

examples.text: It's cold. Let's go inside.

senses.definition: a sports game between two people or teams

examples.text: We won the football match.

translations.zh: 我们赢了那场足球比赛。

senses.definition: to look good together, or to be the same

examples.text: Your shoes match your bag.

senses.definition: almost; not quite

examples.text: It's nearly ten o'clock.

senses.definition: needed; that you must have or do

examples.text: Is it necessary to bring food?

senses.definition: to see or become aware of something

examples.text: Did you notice his new haircut?

translations.zh: 你注意到他的新发型了吗？

senses.definition: a piece of writing that gives information to people

examples.text: Read the notice on the door.

senses.definition: the study of the natural world, such as plants, animals and chemicals

examples.text: Science is my favourite subject.

translations.zh: 科学是我最喜欢的科目。

senses.definition: a building or room where you can buy things

examples.text: The shop opens at nine.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'shop'; American English often says 'store'.

senses.definition: to go to shops to buy things

examples.text: We shop at the market on Saturdays.

translations.zh: 我们星期六去市场买东西。

senses.definition: to rest with your eyes closed, usually at night

examples.text: The baby is sleeping.
I slept for ten hours.

senses.usageNote: 'Sleep' is the state; 'go to sleep' or 'fall asleep' is the moment you start.

senses.definition: a place where trains or buses stop so people can get on and off

examples.text: I'll meet you at the station.

senses.definition: to tell someone you are happy about something they did for you

examples.text: Thank you for your help.

senses.usageNote: Say 'thank you for + noun/-ing': 'Thank you for coming.'

senses.definition: a line of carriages pulled by an engine on a railway

examples.text: We went to London by train.

senses.definition: to practise a sport to get ready for a race or game

examples.text: She trains every day for the race.

senses.definition: to want something that is not true now or that may not happen

examples.text: I wish I could fly.

senses.usageNote: Use 'hope' for things that are possible: 'I hope you pass.' Use 'wish' for things that are unlikely or not true.

senses.definition: something you want to happen

examples.text: Make a wish and blow out the candles!

senses.definition: to keep thinking about problems or bad things that might happen

examples.text: Don't worry. Everything will be fine.

translations.zh: 别担心，一切都会好起来的。

senses.usageNote: Say 'worry about something' or 'be worried about something', not 'worry for'.

senses.definition: to go from one place to another, especially over a distance

examples.text: He travels to Japan twice a year.

senses.usageNote: 'Travel' is usually uncountable as a noun. For one journey say 'a trip' or 'a journey', not 'a travel'.

senses.definition: to be unable to remember something

examples.text: Don't forget your umbrella.

senses.definition: to play a part in a film or play

examples.text: He acts in the school play.

translations.zh: 他在学校的戏剧中演出。

senses.definition: to do something or behave in a certain way

examples.text: We must act quickly.

senses.definition: a piece of writing in a newspaper, magazine or website

examples.text: I read an article about whales.

translations.zh: 我读了一篇关于鲸鱼的文章。

senses.definition: a piece of paper that shows how much you must pay

examples.text: Can we have the bill, please?

senses.definition: a container with flat sides, often made of card or wood

examples.text: The toys are in a big box.

senses.definition: a piece of stiff paper with a picture and a message, sent on special days

examples.text: I made a birthday card for Grandma.

translations.zh: 我给奶奶做了一张生日卡。

senses.definition: a small piece of plastic used to pay for things

examples.text: Can I pay by card?

senses.definition: not dirty

examples.text: My hands are clean now.

senses.definition: to take away the dirt from something

examples.text: I clean my room every Sunday.

translations.zh: 我每个星期天打扫房间。

senses.definition: to say numbers in order, or to find how many things there are

examples.text: Can you count to twenty in English?

translations.zh: 你会用英语从一数到二十吗？

senses.definition: a small round container with a handle, for hot drinks

examples.text: Would you like a cup of tea?

senses.usageNote: A 'cup' usually has a handle and is for hot drinks; a 'glass' is for cold drinks.

senses.definition: a person who buys things from a shop or business

examples.text: The shop was full of customers.

senses.definition: a small fact or piece of information

examples.text: Please send me the details of the trip.

translations.zh: 请把这次旅行的详细信息发给我。

senses.definition: the way that someone or something is going or facing

examples.text: Which direction is the station?

senses.definition: information about how to get to a place (usually 'directions')

examples.text: Can you give me directions to the museum?

translations.zh: 你能告诉我去博物馆怎么走吗？

senses.definition: an animal often kept as a pet, that barks

examples.text: I walk the dog every morning.

senses.definition: pictures and stories in your mind while you sleep

examples.text: I had a strange dream last night.

translations.zh: 我昨晚做了一个奇怪的梦。

senses.usageNote: Say 'have a dream', not 'do a dream'.

senses.definition: something you really want to happen

examples.text: Her dream is to be a pilot.

translations.zh: 她的梦想是当一名飞行员。

senses.definition: to let something fall by accident

examples.text: I dropped my phone on the floor.

senses.definition: without difficulty

examples.text: She won the race easily.

senses.definition: not including

examples.text: Everyone came except Tom.

senses.usageNote: 'Except' leaves something out; 'besides' adds something. Don't mix them up.

senses.definition: movement of your body to stay strong and healthy

examples.text: Swimming is good exercise.

senses.usageNote: In this meaning it is usually uncountable: 'do some exercise', not 'do an exercise'.

senses.definition: a piece of work to help you practise something

examples.text: Do exercise 3 on page 20.

senses.definition: moving or happening quickly

examples.text: This is a very fast train.

translations.zh: 这是一列非常快的火车。

examples.text: He runs faster than me.

senses.usageNote: 'Fast' is both an adjective and an adverb. Say 'run fast', not 'run fastly'.

senses.definition: an animal that lives and swims in water; also its meat as food

examples.text: We had fish for dinner.
There are many fish in the lake.

senses.usageNote: The plural is usually 'fish': 'three fish', not 'three fishes'. As food it is uncountable.

senses.definition: a piece of land next to a house where you can grow flowers and grass

examples.text: The children are playing in the garden.

senses.definition: a cup made of glass, with no handle, for drinking

examples.text: Can I have a glass of water?

senses.definition: a hard clear material used for windows and bottles

examples.text: The table is made of glass.

senses.definition: a point scored when the ball goes into the net in a game

examples.text: He scored a goal in the last minute.

translations.zh: 他在最后一分钟进了一球。

senses.definition: something you want to do in the future

examples.text: My goal is to read fifty books.

translations.zh: 我的目标是读五十本书。

senses.definition: the man that a woman is married to

examples.text: Her husband is a cook.

senses.definition: to make a picture of something in your mind

examples.text: Imagine you are a bird.

senses.definition: a piece of land with water all around it

examples.text: We took a boat to the island.

senses.usageNote: The 's' is silent: /ˈaɪlənd/.

senses.definition: one of the long parts of the body you use to walk and stand

examples.text: A spider has eight legs.

senses.definition: to say something that you know is not true

examples.text: Please don't lie to me.

senses.definition: to be in a flat position, for example on a bed (lie · lay · lain)

examples.text: I want to lie on the sofa.

grammarNotes.irregularForms: lie (say untrue) · lied · lied; lie (be flat) · lay · lain

senses.definition: all right; good enough

examples.text: Are you okay?

senses.definition: what you think or feel about something

examples.text: In my opinion, the book is better than the film.

senses.usageNote: Say 'in my opinion', not 'according to my opinion' or 'on my opinion'.

senses.definition: to send a letter or parcel by mail

examples.text: I posted the card yesterday.

translations.zh: 我昨天把卡片寄出去了。

senses.definition: letters and parcels that are delivered

examples.text: Is there any post for me?

senses.usageNote: British English says 'post'; American English says 'mail'.

senses.definition: to make something ready, or to get ready for something

examples.text: Mum is preparing dinner.
We are preparing for the exam.

translations.zh: 我们正在为考试做准备。

senses.definition: nice to look at; attractive

examples.text: What a pretty dress!

senses.definition: fairly or quite, but not very

examples.text: The test was pretty easy.

senses.definition: to move something towards you

examples.text: Pull the door to open it.

senses.definition: a device you use to listen to music, news and programmes

examples.text: I heard the song on the radio.

translations.zh: 我在广播里听到了这首歌。

senses.definition: a long natural line of water that flows to the sea

examples.text: We walked along the river.

senses.definition: not in danger, or not likely to cause harm

examples.text: Is it safe to swim here?

senses.definition: a girl or woman who has the same parents as you

examples.text: My sister is two years older than me.

senses.usageNote: English doesn't need different words for older and younger: say 'older sister' or 'younger sister' if it matters.

senses.definition: a short piece of music with words that you sing

examples.text: This is my favourite song.

senses.definition: a small bright light that you see in the sky at night

examples.text: We looked at the stars.

senses.definition: a very famous person, such as an actor or singer

examples.text: He's a big film star.

senses.definition: the big star in the sky that gives us light and heat

examples.text: The sun is shining today.

senses.definition: on the day after today

examples.text: See you tomorrow!

senses.definition: a visit to a place and back again

examples.text: We went on a school trip to the museum.

translations.zh: 我们学校组织去博物馆参观。

senses.definition: a recording of moving pictures and sound that you can watch

examples.text: I watched a funny video online.

translations.zh: 我在网上看了一个有趣的视频。

senses.definition: Saturday and Sunday

examples.text: What did you do at the weekend?

senses.usageNote: British English says 'at the weekend'; American English says 'on the weekend'.

senses.definition: used to greet someone who has arrived

examples.text: Welcome to our school!

senses.definition: used in 'you're welcome' as a polite answer to 'thank you'

examples.text: 'Thanks for your help.' 'You're welcome.'

senses.definition: the coldest season of the year, between autumn and spring

examples.text: It snows a lot here in winter.

senses.definition: to reach a place at the end of a journey

examples.text: We arrived at the airport an hour early.

translations.zh: 我们提前一小时到了机场。

senses.usageNote: 'Arrive in' a city or country; 'arrive at' a building or a point. Never 'arrive to'.

senses.definition: a round object used in games and sports

examples.text: Kick the ball to me!

senses.definition: in a lower place than something

examples.text: It was below zero last night.

senses.definition: the money used in the US and some other countries

examples.text: This T-shirt costs ten dollars.

senses.definition: the number 8

examples.text: School starts at eight o'clock.

senses.definition: a message sent from one computer or phone to another

examples.text: I got an email from my cousin.

translations.zh: 我收到了表哥的一封电子邮件。

senses.definition: to send someone an email

examples.text: Please email me the photos.

translations.zh: 请把照片用邮件发给我。

senses.definition: something you feel inside, like being happy, sad or afraid

examples.text: I have a feeling it will rain.
Try not to hurt her feelings.

senses.definition: to move through the air, or to travel by plane

examples.text: Birds can fly.
We flew to Beijing last week.

translations.zh: 我们上周坐飞机去了北京。

senses.definition: a small insect with two wings

examples.text: There's a fly in the kitchen.

senses.definition: enjoyment; a good time

examples.text: We had a lot of fun at the party.

translations.zh: 我们在聚会上玩得很开心。

senses.usageNote: 'Fun' means enjoyable; 'funny' means it makes you laugh. A trip can be fun without being funny.

senses.definition: a building where you pay to sleep and eat when you travel

examples.text: We stayed in a hotel near the beach.

translations.zh: 我们住在海边附近的一家酒店。

senses.definition: making you want to know more; not boring

examples.text: This is an interesting book.

senses.definition: to tell people each other's names when they meet for the first time

examples.text: Let me introduce my friend Lily.

translations.zh: 我来介绍一下我的朋友莉莉。

senses.usageNote: Say 'introduce A to B', not 'introduce B A'. 'Can I introduce you to my sister?'

senses.definition: the room where you cook food

examples.text: Mum is cooking in the kitchen.

senses.definition: liked by a lot of people

examples.text: Football is very popular in Brazil.

senses.definition: to move something away from you with your hands or body

examples.text: Can you help me push the car?

senses.definition: something that you sit on, such as a chair

examples.text: Is this seat free?

senses.usageNote: 'Take a seat' is a polite way to say 'sit down'.

senses.definition: a game or activity in which you move your body, often in a team

examples.text: What's your favourite sport?

senses.definition: the season between winter and summer, when plants start to grow

examples.text: The trees get new leaves in spring.

senses.definition: a written message sent from one phone to another

examples.text: I sent her a text.

senses.definition: to send a written message by phone

examples.text: Text me when you get home.

senses.definition: to put your hand or finger on something

examples.text: Please don't touch the paintings.

senses.definition: a very small town in the countryside

examples.text: My grandparents live in a quiet village.

translations.zh: 我的祖父母住在一个安静的村子里。

senses.definition: on the day before today

examples.text: I saw Tom yesterday.

senses.definition: at a fast speed; in a short time

examples.text: She learns new words very quickly.

senses.definition: the part of the day between midday and evening

examples.text: I have a piano lesson this afternoon.

senses.usageNote: Say 'in the afternoon' but 'on Monday afternoon'.

senses.definition: without other people

examples.text: She lives alone in a small flat.

translations.zh: 她独自住在一套小公寓里。

senses.usageNote: 'Alone' means with nobody else and is not always sad. For the sad feeling, use 'lonely'.

senses.definition: a person who paints, draws or makes art

examples.text: The artist painted a picture of the sea.

translations.zh: 那位画家画了一幅大海的画。

senses.definition: an animal with feathers and wings

examples.text: A bird is singing in the tree.

senses.definition: to write or make something exactly the same as something else

examples.text: Copy the words into your notebook.

translations.zh: 把这些单词抄到你的笔记本上。

senses.definition: one thing that is the same as another

examples.text: Can I have a copy of the list?

senses.definition: the main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening

examples.text: What's for dinner tonight?

senses.definition: a person who drives a car, bus or other vehicle

examples.text: The taxi driver was very friendly.

translations.zh: 那位出租车司机很友好。

senses.definition: with no water or liquid

examples.text: Are the clothes dry yet?

senses.definition: to take the water away from something

examples.text: Dry your hands on the towel.

senses.definition: more than the usual amount

examples.text: Bring an extra jumper in case it's cold.

translations.zh: 多带一件毛衣以防天冷。

senses.definition: treating everyone in the same, right way

examples.text: That's not fair! It's my turn.

senses.definition: light in colour, used about hair or skin

examples.text: She has fair hair.

senses.definition: to be the right size and shape for someone or something

examples.text: These shoes don't fit me.

senses.usageNote: 'Fit' is about size; 'suit' is about looking good. 'The dress fits you' = right size.

senses.definition: healthy and strong, often because you do exercise

examples.text: She swims every day to keep fit.

translations.zh: 她每天游泳来保持健康。

senses.definition: a large room for meetings or events, or the space inside the front door of a house

examples.text: The concert is in the school hall.

translations.zh: 音乐会在学校礼堂举行。

senses.definition: weighing a lot; hard to lift

examples.text: This box is too heavy for me.

translations.zh: 这个箱子对我来说太重了。

examples.text: There was heavy rain last night.

senses.usageNote: Use 'heavy rain' and 'heavy traffic', not 'big rain' or 'big traffic'.

senses.definition: to feel pain, or to cause pain to a part of the body

examples.text: My leg hurts.
He hurt his knee playing football.

senses.definition: the system that connects computers around the world

examples.text: I found the answer on the internet.

senses.usageNote: Use 'the': 'on the internet'.

senses.definition: to make sounds with your voice because something is funny

examples.text: The children laughed at the clown.

translations.zh: 孩子们看着小丑哈哈大笑。

senses.usageNote: 'Laugh at someone' can mean making fun of them, which is unkind.

senses.definition: having a husband or wife

examples.text: My aunt is married with two children.

translations.zh: 我姑姑已经结婚了，有两个孩子。

senses.usageNote: Say 'married to someone', not 'married with someone'. 'Get married' is the action.

senses.definition: a very high hill

examples.text: We climbed a mountain last summer.

translations.zh: 我们去年夏天爬了一座山。

senses.definition: a person you do an activity or work with

examples.text: Work with a partner and ask these questions.

translations.zh: 和搭档一起练习，问这些问题。

senses.definition: the money used in the UK; one pound has 100 pence

examples.text: This T-shirt costs ten pounds.

senses.definition: unusual or surprising, often in a way you don't understand

examples.text: What a strange noise!

senses.definition: to stop sleeping

examples.text: I wake up at seven every day.
examples.cloze: I {{wake up}} at seven every day.

examples.text: Please don't wake up the baby.

senses.usageNote: 'Wake up' is when you stop sleeping; 'get up' is when you get out of bed.

senses.definition: the bad feeling you have in your body when you are hurt or ill

examples.text: I have a pain in my back.

senses.definition: the number and street where someone lives, or the details used to send an email

examples.text: What is your email address?

translations.zh: 你的电子邮件地址是什么？

senses.definition: in or to any place

examples.text: I can't find my pen anywhere.

translations.zh: 我哪儿都找不到我的笔。

senses.definition: a container made of cloth, paper or plastic for carrying things

examples.text: Put your books in your bag.

senses.definition: a group of people who play music together

examples.text: My brother plays the guitar in a band.

translations.zh: 我哥哥在一个乐队里弹吉他。

senses.definition: a small vehicle that travels on water

examples.text: We went across the lake by boat.

senses.definition: the lowest part of something

examples.text: Write your name at the bottom of the page.

translations.zh: 在这页底部写上你的名字。

senses.definition: having the colour of chocolate or wood

examples.text: He has brown eyes.

senses.definition: a large road vehicle that carries many passengers

examples.text: I go to school by bus.

senses.usageNote: Say 'by bus' (no 'a' or 'the'), or 'on the bus'.

senses.definition: a seat for one person, with a back and usually four legs

examples.text: Please sit on this chair.

senses.definition: to get and keep things of one type as a hobby

examples.text: He collects stamps from other countries.

senses.definition: to go and get someone or something from a place

examples.text: Mum collects me from school at four.

senses.definition: an event where people try to win something

examples.text: She won a singing competition.

translations.zh: 她赢得了一场歌唱比赛。

senses.definition: a talk between two or more people

examples.text: We had a long conversation on the phone.

translations.zh: 我们在电话里聊了很久。

senses.definition: a little cold, in a pleasant way

examples.text: It's nice and cool in the shade.

senses.definition: very good or fashionable (informal)

examples.text: Your new trainers are really cool!

senses.definition: to go from one side of something to the other

examples.text: Look both ways before you cross the road.

senses.definition: a mark like x or +

examples.text: Put a cross next to the wrong answers.

senses.definition: an informal word for father

examples.text: My dad is a bus driver.

senses.definition: to move your body to music

examples.text: She loves to dance.

senses.definition: a set of movements you do to music

examples.text: We learned a new dance today.

translations.zh: 我们今天学了一支新舞。

senses.definition: to make something full

examples.text: Fill the bottle with water.
Please fill in this form.

senses.usageNote: 'Fill in a form' means write the answers in the spaces.

senses.definition: a person who shows visitors around a place

examples.text: Our guide told us about the old city.

translations.zh: 导游给我们介绍了这座古城。

senses.definition: to dislike something or someone very much

examples.text: I hate getting up early.

senses.definition: a large animal that people ride or use for pulling things

examples.text: Can you ride a horse?

senses.definition: a polite word for a woman

examples.text: The lady at the desk was very helpful.

translations.zh: 前台的那位女士很热心。

senses.definition: something that is wrong or not correct

senses.definition: the part of your face that you eat and speak with

examples.text: Don't talk with your mouth full.

senses.definition: an informal word for mother

examples.text: Mum, can I have a biscuit?

translations.zh: 妈妈，我可以吃块饼干吗？

senses.usageNote: British English says 'mum'; American English says 'mom'.

senses.definition: no person; not anyone

examples.text: Nobody was at home.

senses.usageNote: 'Nobody' takes a singular verb and no 'not': 'Nobody knows', not 'Nobody doesn't know'.

senses.definition: using the internet

examples.text: I bought these shoes online.

senses.definition: so good that it could not be better; with nothing wrong

examples.text: The weather was perfect for a picnic.

senses.definition: fast, or taking only a short time

examples.text: Can I ask a quick question?

translations.zh: 我能问个简短的问题吗？

senses.definition: to sit on a bike or horse and control it as it moves

examples.text: I ride my bike to school.
She rode a horse on holiday.

senses.definition: a hot drink made by pouring water onto dried leaves

examples.text: Would you like a cup of tea?

senses.definition: in British English, a small meal in the afternoon or an early evening meal

examples.text: What's for tea tonight?

senses.definition: to send something through the air with your hand

examples.text: Throw the ball to me!
He threw the paper in the bin.
examples.cloze: He {{threw}} the paper in the bin.

senses.definition: having a lot to do

examples.text: I'm busy this afternoon.

senses.definition: the conditions outside — rain, sun, wind, temperature

examples.text: The weather has been terrible all week.

senses.usageNote: Uncountable: 'the weather is', never 'a weather'.

senses.definition: always busy doing things, especially moving your body

examples.text: My grandma is still very active.

senses.definition: feeling fear

examples.text: My little brother is afraid of dogs.

senses.usageNote: Say 'afraid of something'. 'I'm afraid...' is also a polite way to give bad news: 'I'm afraid I can't come.'

senses.definition: any person

examples.text: Does anybody have a pencil?

senses.definition: the first part of something

examples.text: The beginning of the film was funny.

senses.usageNote: Say 'at the beginning of' something: 'at the beginning of May'.

senses.definition: to hurt or damage something with fire or heat

examples.text: I burned the toast again.

senses.definition: the place where two lines, walls or streets meet

examples.text: The shop is on the corner.

senses.usageNote: Say 'in the corner' of a room, but 'on the corner' of a street.

senses.definition: to have tears coming from your eyes because you are sad or hurt

examples.text: The baby cried all night.

senses.definition: likely to hurt you or cause problems

examples.text: It's dangerous to swim here.

senses.definition: to get money for work that you do

examples.text: She earns pocket money by washing the car.

senses.definition: very, very good

examples.text: You did an excellent job!

senses.definition: known by very many people

examples.text: She wants to be a famous singer.

translations.zh: 她想成为一名著名歌手。

examples.text: Paris is famous for its food.

senses.usageNote: Say 'famous for something': 'This town is famous for its tea.'

senses.definition: belonging to the sex that can have babies or lay eggs

examples.text: The female bird sits on the eggs.

senses.definition: a set of rooms for living in, on one floor of a building

examples.text: They live in a small flat in town.

translations.zh: 他们住在城里的一套小公寓里。

senses.usageNote: British English says 'flat'; American English says 'apartment'.

senses.definition: smooth and level, with no high or low parts

examples.text: The land here is very flat.

senses.definition: recently made, picked or bought; not old

examples.text: I like fresh bread in the morning.

translations.zh: 我喜欢早上吃新鲜面包。

examples.text: Open the window for some fresh air.

senses.definition: to give an answer when you are not sure it is right

examples.text: Guess what's in the box.
I guessed the answer correctly.

senses.definition: a high area of land, smaller than a mountain

examples.text: We walked up the hill.

senses.definition: wanting to know more about something

examples.text: I'm interested in science.

senses.usageNote: People are 'interested in' things; things are 'interesting'. Don't say 'I am interesting in music'.

senses.definition: a large area of water with land all around it

examples.text: We swam in the lake.

senses.definition: a time when you are taught something

examples.text: I have a piano lesson on Friday.

senses.definition: a small room that carries people up and down in a building

examples.text: Let's take the lift to the fifth floor.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'lift'; American English says 'elevator'.

senses.definition: to move something up

examples.text: Can you lift this box?

senses.definition: to try to find something or someone

examples.text: Can you help me look for my glasses?
examples.cloze: Can you help me {{look for}} my glasses?

senses.definition: the meal you eat in the middle of the day

examples.text: What did you have for lunch?

senses.usageNote: No 'the' with meals in general: 'have lunch', not 'have the lunch'.

senses.definition: belonging to the sex that cannot have babies or lay eggs

examples.text: The male lion has a big mane.

senses.definition: large printed sheets of paper with news, that come out every day or week

examples.text: Grandpa reads the newspaper every morning.

senses.definition: a picture that you make with a camera or phone

examples.text: Can you take a photo of us?

senses.usageNote: Say 'take a photo', not 'shoot a photo' or 'make a photo'.

senses.definition: one of four equal parts; 15 minutes when you say the time

examples.text: It's a quarter past nine.

senses.definition: having a lot of money

examples.text: He became rich after selling his company.

translations.zh: 他卖掉公司后变得富有了。

senses.definition: to make a sound like a bell, or to phone someone

examples.text: Your phone is ringing.

senses.definition: a round piece of jewellery you wear on your finger

examples.text: She wears a silver ring.

senses.definition: a large boat that carries people or goods across the sea

examples.text: The ship sailed across the ocean.

senses.definition: to make music with your voice

examples.text: The children sing a song every morning.

translations.zh: 孩子们每天早上唱一首歌。

examples.text: We sang Happy Birthday.

senses.definition: to make a happy face with the corners of your mouth turned up

examples.text: She smiled at me.

senses.definition: during the evening or night of today

examples.text: What are you doing tonight?

senses.definition: helping you to do something

examples.text: This app is very useful for learning words.

translations.zh: 这个应用对学单词很有用。

senses.definition: air that moves outside

examples.text: The wind is very strong today.

senses.definition: two things of the same kind that are used together

examples.text: I need a new pair of shoes.

senses.usageNote: Use 'a pair of' with things that have two parts, too: a pair of trousers, a pair of glasses, a pair of scissors.

senses.definition: needing rest or sleep

examples.text: I was too tired to cook.

senses.usageNote: 'Tired of something' means bored with it, not sleepy: 'I'm tired of waiting.'

senses.definition: a person who is fully grown

examples.text: The ticket is ten pounds for an adult.

senses.definition: ideas you give someone about what they should do

examples.text: Can you give me some advice?

senses.usageNote: 'Advice' is uncountable: say 'some advice' or 'a piece of advice', not 'an advice' or 'advices'. The verb is 'advise'.

senses.definition: a structure built over a river or road so people can cross it

examples.text: The bridge goes over the river.

senses.definition: money in coins or notes

examples.text: Can I pay in cash?

senses.usageNote: 'Cash' is uncountable: 'some cash', not 'a cash'. Say 'pay in cash' or 'pay by card'.

senses.definition: the things you wear, such as shirts and trousers

examples.text: I need some new clothes.

senses.usageNote: 'Clothes' is always plural and has no singular form: say 'a piece of clothing', not 'a clothe'.

senses.definition: a hot brown drink made from roasted beans

examples.text: My parents drink coffee every morning.

translations.zh: 我父母每天早上喝咖啡。

senses.definition: to make food ready to eat by heating it

examples.text: Dad cooks dinner on Fridays.

senses.usageNote: A 'cook' is a person; a 'cooker' is the machine you cook on.

senses.definition: a person who cooks food

examples.text: My grandma is a great cook.

senses.definition: right, with no mistakes

examples.text: All your answers are correct.

senses.definition: happening every day

examples.text: Walking the dog is part of my daily routine.

translations.zh: 遛狗是我每天的例行事务。

senses.definition: used at the start of a letter or email

examples.text: Dear Anna, thank you for your letter.

translations.zh: 亲爱的安娜，谢谢你的来信。

senses.definition: two times as big, or having two parts

examples.text: We booked a double room.

senses.definition: the part of a vehicle that makes it move

examples.text: The car's engine is very quiet.

translations.zh: 这辆车的发动机很安静。

senses.definition: in or to all places

examples.text: I looked everywhere for my keys.

senses.definition: used in 'excuse me' to politely get someone's attention or say sorry

examples.text: Excuse me, where is the station?

senses.definition: a reason you give for doing something wrong

examples.text: He always has an excuse for being late.

senses.usageNote: As a noun, 'excuse' ends with an 's' sound: /ɪkˈskjuːs/.

senses.definition: land and buildings where people grow food and keep animals

examples.text: There are cows and sheep on the farm.

senses.usageNote: We say 'on a farm', not 'in a farm'.

senses.definition: one of the five long parts at the end of your hand

examples.text: She pointed at the map with her finger.

senses.definition: a game in which two teams kick a ball and try to get it into a goal

examples.text: The boys play football after school.

senses.usageNote: Use 'play football', not 'play the football'. In American English it is called 'soccer'.

senses.definition: a valuable yellow metal

examples.text: She won a gold medal.

senses.definition: an empty space or opening in something

examples.text: There's a hole in my sock.

senses.definition: a place where you can read or borrow books

examples.text: I borrowed this book from the library.

translations.zh: 我从图书馆借了这本书。

senses.usageNote: A library lends books; a bookshop sells them.

senses.definition: the food you eat at one time, like breakfast or dinner

examples.text: We have three meals a day.

senses.definition: a building where you can see old, interesting or beautiful things

examples.text: We visited the science museum.

translations.zh: 我们参观了科学博物馆。

senses.definition: a person whose job is to look after ill or hurt people, often in a hospital

examples.text: The nurse gave me some water.

senses.definition: making very little noise

examples.text: Please be quiet in the library.

translations.zh: 在图书馆里请保持安静。

senses.usageNote: Don't mix up 'quiet' (安静) with 'quite' (相当). They are spelt differently.

senses.definition: a place where you buy and eat a meal

examples.text: Let's eat at the Italian restaurant.

translations.zh: 我们去那家意大利餐馆吃吧。

senses.definition: a large hard piece of stone

examples.text: We sat on a big rock by the sea.

translations.zh: 我们坐在海边的一块大石头上。

senses.definition: a type of loud popular music

examples.text: My brother loves rock music.

senses.definition: the space above the earth where you see the sun, moon and clouds

examples.text: The sky is clear and blue today.

senses.definition: not fast; taking a long time

examples.text: The internet is very slow today.

senses.definition: in a line, without turning

examples.text: Go straight on, then turn left.

senses.definition: not bent or curly

examples.text: She has long straight hair.

senses.definition: something that happens that you did not expect

examples.text: We made a surprise cake for Mum.

translations.zh: 我们给妈妈做了一个惊喜蛋糕。

senses.definition: how hot or cold something is

examples.text: The temperature is 30 degrees today.

senses.definition: a body heat that is higher than normal because you are ill

examples.text: The baby has a temperature.

senses.definition: a building where people go to watch plays and shows

examples.text: We went to the theatre last night.

senses.definition: a little hot, in a nice way

examples.text: It's warm today. Let's sit outside.

translations.zh: 今天很暖和，我们坐外面吧。

senses.definition: not strong; without much power

examples.text: I felt weak after being ill.

senses.definition: very good; making you feel very happy

examples.text: We had a wonderful time at the beach.

translations.zh: 我们在海滩玩得非常开心。

senses.definition: to do something repeatedly in order to get better at it

examples.text: He practises the piano every evening.

senses.usageNote: British English: 'practise' is the verb, 'practice' the noun. American English uses 'practice' for both.

senses.definition: full of light, or having a strong colour

examples.text: She wore a bright yellow coat.

translations.zh: 她穿着一件鲜黄色的外套。

senses.definition: clever and quick to learn

examples.text: He is a bright boy.

senses.definition: the most important city of a country, where the government is

examples.text: Beijing is the capital of China.

senses.definition: a big letter, such as A, B or C

examples.text: Start a sentence with a capital letter.

translations.zh: 句子要以大写字母开头。

senses.definition: a small animal with soft fur, often kept as a pet

examples.text: Our cat sleeps on my bed.

senses.definition: a person who likes a sport, team, singer or film star very much

examples.text: I am a big fan of this band.

translations.zh: 我是这个乐队的铁杆粉丝。

senses.definition: a machine with turning blades that moves air to make you cool

examples.text: Turn on the fan, it's hot.

senses.definition: a journey in a plane

examples.text: Our flight leaves at six.

senses.definition: the soft sweet part of a plant that you can eat, like apples and bananas

examples.text: Eat more fruit and vegetables.

senses.usageNote: 'Fruit' is usually uncountable: 'I eat a lot of fruit', not 'a lot of fruits'. For one, say 'a piece of fruit'.

senses.definition: to ask someone to come to a party, meal or event

examples.text: She invited me to her birthday party.

translations.zh: 她邀请我参加她的生日聚会。

senses.definition: a trip from one place to another

examples.text: The journey to school takes twenty minutes.

senses.definition: a vehicle with wings that flies in the sky

examples.text: The plane lands at six o'clock.

senses.usageNote: Say 'by plane' or 'on a plane': 'We went by plane.'

senses.definition: the part of your body between your neck and the top of your arm

examples.text: She put her bag on her shoulder.

senses.definition: having the colour of a lemon or the sun

examples.text: She painted the door yellow.

senses.definition: a period of time away from work or school, often spent travelling

examples.text: We're going on holiday in August.

senses.usageNote: British English 'on holiday'; American English 'on vacation'.

senses.definition: having a strong feeling of not being pleased

examples.text: Dad was angry about the broken window.

translations.zh: 爸爸因为窗户被打破而生气。

senses.usageNote: Say 'angry with someone' and 'angry about something'.

senses.definition: an area of sand or stones next to the sea

examples.text: We played on the beach all day.

translations.zh: 我们在海滩上玩了一整天。

senses.definition: the person in charge of you at work

examples.text: My boss is very kind.

senses.definition: a piece of equipment for taking photos or videos

examples.text: Don't forget your camera!

senses.definition: a place where people stay in tents for a short time

examples.text: I went to summer camp last year.

senses.definition: to stay in a tent for a holiday

examples.text: We camped near the lake.

senses.definition: to ride a bicycle

examples.text: I cycle to school when it's sunny.

senses.definition: a table where you read, write or work

examples.text: My books are on my desk.

senses.definition: a round or oval thing laid by a bird, often eaten as food

examples.text: I had two eggs for breakfast.

senses.definition: with nothing or nobody inside

examples.text: The fridge is empty.

senses.definition: to repair something that is broken

examples.text: Dad fixed my bike.

translations.zh: 爸爸修好了我的自行车。

senses.definition: the coloured part of a plant, or a plant grown for it

examples.text: She gave her mum some flowers.

senses.definition: to get out of bed after sleeping

examples.text: I get up at seven every day.
examples.cloze: I {{get up}} at seven every day.

senses.usageNote: 'Wake up' is when you stop sleeping; 'get up' is when you leave your bed.

senses.definition: a person you invite to your home or party, or who stays at a hotel

examples.text: We have guests for dinner tonight.

translations.zh: 我们今晚有客人来吃饭。

senses.definition: water that has become hard because it is very cold

examples.text: Do you want ice in your drink?

senses.definition: to push yourself up into the air with your legs

examples.text: The cat jumped onto the table.

senses.definition: a picture that shows where places, roads and rivers are

examples.text: Let's look at the map.

senses.definition: the white drink that comes from cows and some other animals

examples.text: I drink milk every morning.

senses.definition: the part of the body between your head and shoulders

examples.text: A giraffe has a very long neck.

senses.definition: a sound, often a loud or unpleasant one

examples.text: Please don't make so much noise.

senses.usageNote: Say 'make a noise' or 'make noise', not 'do noise'.

senses.definition: on the other side, facing someone or something

examples.text: The bank is opposite the park.

senses.definition: a person or thing that is completely different from another

examples.text: The opposite of 'hot' is 'cold'.

senses.definition: to like one thing more than another

examples.text: I prefer tea to coffee.

senses.usageNote: Use 'prefer A to B', not 'prefer A than B'. The past is 'preferred', with double r.

senses.definition: water that falls from the clouds in drops

examples.text: We walked home in the rain.

senses.definition: when rain falls from the sky

examples.text: It's raining again.

senses.usageNote: Use 'it' as the subject: 'It is raining', not 'The rain is raining'.

senses.definition: to answer someone by speaking or writing

examples.text: She replied to my message quickly.

translations.zh: 她很快回复了我的消息。

senses.usageNote: Say 'reply to a message', not 'reply a message'.

senses.definition: not hard or rough; nice to touch

examples.text: This pillow is really soft.

senses.definition: very bad

examples.text: The food was terrible.

senses.definition: the cars, buses and other vehicles on a road

examples.text: There was a lot of traffic this morning.

senses.usageNote: 'Traffic' is uncountable: say 'a lot of traffic' or 'heavy traffic', not 'many traffics'.

senses.definition: a person who comes to see a place or a person

examples.text: The museum has many visitors every day.

translations.zh: 这家博物馆每天都有很多参观者。

senses.definition: to clean something with water, and often soap

examples.text: Wash your hands before dinner.

senses.definition: the hard material that trees are made of

examples.text: The table is made of wood.

senses.definition: a small forest; often 'the woods'

examples.text: We went for a walk in the woods.

senses.definition: at a low speed; taking a long time

examples.text: Could you speak more slowly, please?

senses.definition: something bad that happens by chance, often causing damage

examples.text: There was a small accident on the road.

translations.zh: 路上发生了一起小事故。

senses.usageNote: 'By accident' means 'not on purpose': 'I broke the cup by accident.'

senses.definition: a person whose job is to perform in films or plays

examples.text: He wants to be an actor.

senses.definition: a large, strong wild animal with thick fur

examples.text: We saw a brown bear at the zoo.

translations.zh: 我们在动物园看到一只棕熊。

senses.definition: a glass or plastic container with a narrow top, for liquids

examples.text: I bought a bottle of water.

senses.definition: a large group of people in one place

examples.text: A big crowd watched the game.

senses.definition: a piece of clothing for a woman or girl that covers the body and part of the legs

examples.text: She's wearing a red dress.

translations.zh: 她穿着一条红色连衣裙。

senses.definition: to put clothes on (often 'get dressed')

examples.text: Get dressed quickly, we're late!

translations.zh: 快穿衣服，我们要迟到了！

senses.definition: a large area of land covered with trees

examples.text: Many animals live in the forest.

translations.zh: 很多动物生活在森林里。

senses.definition: kind and pleasant to other people

examples.text: Our new neighbours are very friendly.

senses.usageNote: 'Friendly' is an adjective, not an adverb. Say 'He smiled in a friendly way', not 'He smiled friendly'.

senses.definition: making you laugh

examples.text: He told us a funny story.

translations.zh: 他给我们讲了一个好笑的故事。

senses.definition: strange or unusual

examples.text: This milk tastes funny.

senses.definition: to go or put something where no one can see or find it

examples.text: The cat likes to hide under the bed.
I hid the present in the cupboard.
examples.cloze: I {{hid}} the present in the cupboard.

translations.zh: 我把礼物藏在了柜子里。

senses.definition: to say or do something again

examples.text: Could you repeat that, please?

senses.usageNote: 'Repeat' already means 'again', so don't say 'repeat again'.

senses.definition: the top covering of a building or car

examples.text: There's a bird on the roof.

senses.definition: a covering for your foot, usually made of leather

examples.text: Take off your shoes, please.

senses.definition: a substance you take to treat an illness

examples.text: Take this medicine twice a day.

senses.definition: the day each year when you remember the day you were born

examples.text: Happy birthday, Tom!

senses.definition: the first meal of the day

examples.text: What did you have for breakfast?

senses.usageNote: Say 'have breakfast' with no 'a' or 'the'.

senses.definition: a farm bird kept for its eggs and meat, or the meat of this bird

examples.text: We had chicken and rice for dinner.

translations.zh: 我们晚饭吃了鸡肉和米饭。

senses.definition: a round shape like the letter O

examples.text: Draw a circle on the paper.

senses.definition: to go up something using your hands and feet

examples.text: The boys climbed the tree.

senses.usageNote: The 'b' in 'climb' is silent.

senses.definition: pleasant to sit in, wear or be in

examples.text: This sofa is really comfortable.

senses.usageNote: It is usually said with three syllables: /ˈkʌmf-tə-bl/.

senses.definition: very silly or strange (informal)

examples.text: That's a crazy idea!

senses.definition: liking something very much (informal)

examples.text: He's crazy about football.

senses.definition: the food that you usually eat

examples.text: A healthy diet has lots of fruit.

translations.zh: 健康的饮食包括大量水果。

senses.definition: one of the two parts of your head that you hear with

examples.text: Rabbits have long ears.

senses.definition: having a big, round body with a lot of flesh

examples.text: Our cat is getting fat.
