senses.definition: something you give to someone, for example on their birthday

examples.text: Thank you for the lovely gift.

senses.definition: having the colour between black and white, like clouds before rain

examples.text: The sky is grey today.

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'grey'; American spelling is 'gray'.

senses.definition: well and strong, or good for your body

examples.text: Try to eat healthy food.

senses.definition: good or bad things that happen by chance

examples.text: Good luck with your exam!

senses.definition: a thin book with pictures and stories that comes out every week or month

examples.text: She reads a science magazine.

senses.definition: parts of an animal that people eat as food

examples.text: I don't eat much meat.

senses.definition: to put different things together so they become one

examples.text: Mix the flour and the eggs.

translations.zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋搅拌在一起。

senses.definition: the round thing that goes around the earth and shines in the sky at night

examples.text: The moon is very bright tonight.

senses.definition: the part of your face that you breathe and smell with

examples.text: The clown has a red nose.

senses.definition: a very large area of sea

examples.text: Whales live in the ocean.

senses.definition: a light, strong material made in factories and used for many things

examples.text: This bottle is made of plastic.

senses.definition: ill; not well

examples.text: Tom is sick, so he stayed home.

translations.zh: 汤姆病了，所以他待在家里。

senses.usageNote: In British English, 'feel sick' usually means you think you are going to vomit.

senses.definition: higher than most other people or things

examples.text: My dad is very tall.

senses.usageNote: Use 'tall' for people, trees and buildings. Use 'high' for mountains, walls and prices.

senses.definition: two times

examples.text: I brush my teeth twice a day.

senses.usageNote: Say 'once', 'twice', then 'three times', 'four times'.

senses.definition: not true or not correct

examples.text: Is this sentence true or false?

senses.definition: a door in a fence or wall outside, or the place where you get on a plane

examples.text: Please close the gate.
Our flight leaves from Gate 12.

translations.zh: 我们的航班从12号登机口出发。

senses.definition: something you get for winning a game or competition

examples.text: She won first prize in the art contest.

translations.zh: 她在美术比赛中获得了一等奖。

senses.definition: costing a lot of money

examples.text: Flights are more expensive in July.

senses.definition: not well

examples.text: I played badly in the match today.

senses.definition: a room for sleeping in

examples.text: My bedroom is small but nice.

translations.zh: 我的卧室很小，但很舒适。

senses.definition: one of the hard white parts inside your body

examples.text: The dog is playing with a bone.

senses.definition: a white or grey mass in the sky made of small drops of water

examples.text: There isn't a cloud in the sky.

senses.definition: a warm piece of clothing with long sleeves that you wear outside

examples.text: Put your coat on, it's cold.

senses.definition: a person who designs or builds machines, roads or bridges

examples.text: My uncle is an engineer.

senses.definition: a style of clothes or hair that is popular at a certain time

examples.text: She loves fashion and design.
Big glasses are in fashion now.

senses.definition: a special day or time when people celebrate something, often with music or food

examples.text: We eat mooncakes at the Mid-Autumn Festival.

senses.definition: something funny that you say to make people laugh

examples.text: Dad told a funny joke.

translations.zh: 爸爸讲了个好笑的笑话。

senses.definition: very nice, pretty or enjoyable

examples.text: What a lovely day!

senses.definition: a round sweet fruit with a thick skin

examples.text: I eat an orange every day.

senses.definition: having the colour between red and yellow

examples.text: She has an orange dress.

senses.definition: a large hole filled with water that people swim in

examples.text: The hotel has a pool.

senses.definition: to say something very loudly

examples.text: Don't shout. I can hear you.

senses.usageNote: 'Shout at someone' often means you are angry; 'shout to someone' means you want them to hear you.

senses.definition: tasting of sugar

examples.text: This cake is too sweet for me.

translations.zh: 这块蛋糕对我来说太甜了。

senses.definition: a small piece of sweet food, such as a chocolate

examples.text: Don't eat too many sweets.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'sweets'; American English says 'candy'.

senses.definition: a printed piece of paper or a code that shows you have paid to travel or enter

examples.text: Two tickets to Chiang Mai, please.

translations.zh: 请给我两张去清迈的票。

senses.definition: liked more than all others

examples.text: This is my favourite song.

senses.usageNote: American English spells it 'favorite'. 'Favourite' is already a superlative — never 'most favourite'.

senses.definition: thinking about what you do so that nothing bad happens

examples.text: Be careful when you cross the road.

senses.definition: a building where people or machines make things in large numbers

examples.text: My uncle works in a car factory.

translations.zh: 我叔叔在一家汽车厂工作。

senses.definition: a common green plant with thin leaves that covers the ground

examples.text: Please don't walk on the grass.

senses.definition: a tool with a sharp edge for cutting

examples.text: Cut the bread with a knife.

senses.definition: having good things happen to you by chance

examples.text: You're lucky to have a garden.

senses.definition: a little afraid or worried about something that will happen

examples.text: I always feel nervous before exams.

senses.definition: to put colour on something, or to make a picture with colours

examples.text: We painted the kitchen yellow.

translations.zh: 我们把厨房漆成了黄色。

examples.text: She likes to paint flowers.

senses.definition: a coloured liquid that you put on walls or use to make pictures

examples.text: Don't touch the door. The paint is still wet.

senses.definition: a small bag sewn into clothes for keeping things in

examples.text: My keys are in my pocket.

senses.definition: the activity of buying things in shops

examples.text: Let's go shopping this afternoon.

translations.zh: 我们今天下午去购物吧。

senses.usageNote: Say 'go shopping' and 'do the shopping' (= buy food for the home).

senses.definition: to have a particular smell, or to notice a smell with your nose

examples.text: This soup smells good!

senses.usageNote: Use an adjective after 'smell': 'It smells good', not 'It smells well'.

senses.definition: costing little money

examples.text: We found a cheap hotel near the station.

translations.zh: 我们在车站附近找到一家便宜的旅馆。

senses.usageNote: 'Cheap' can suggest poor quality. For a good price with no such hint, use 'inexpensive' or 'good value'.

senses.definition: after something else has happened

examples.text: We had lunch and went swimming afterwards.

translations.zh: 我们吃了午饭，之后去游泳了。

senses.definition: a place where planes take off and land

examples.text: We got to the airport early.

senses.definition: very surprising and very good

examples.text: The view from the top was amazing.

senses.definition: the sister of your mother or father, or your uncle's wife

examples.text: My aunt lives in Shanghai.

senses.definition: a food made from flour and water, baked in an oven

examples.text: I have bread and eggs for breakfast.

senses.usageNote: 'Bread' is uncountable: say 'some bread' or 'a slice of bread', not 'a bread' or 'breads'.

senses.definition: a machine that shows the time, often on a wall

examples.text: The clock in the kitchen is slow.

senses.usageNote: A 'clock' is on a wall or table; a 'watch' is worn on your wrist.

senses.definition: a show where people play music for an audience

examples.text: We went to a concert in the park.

translations.zh: 我们去公园听了一场音乐会。

senses.definition: acting in plays, or a play or TV show that is serious

examples.text: We have drama lessons on Tuesday.

senses.definition: making you feel very happy and interested

examples.text: The football match was really exciting.

senses.definition: a person who owns or works on a farm

examples.text: The farmer gets up very early.

senses.definition: pleased and happy about something

examples.text: I'm glad you came.

senses.usageNote: 'Glad' is not used before a noun. Say 'a happy child', not 'a glad child'.

senses.definition: something you wear on your head

examples.text: Wear a hat, it's sunny.

senses.definition: not well; having a sickness

examples.text: Tom is ill today, so he's at home.

translations.zh: 汤姆今天生病了，所以在家。

senses.definition: a problem with your health; being ill

examples.text: He missed school because of illness.

senses.definition: the middle part of your leg, where it bends

examples.text: I fell and hurt my knee.

senses.usageNote: The 'k' is silent: /niː/.

senses.definition: making a lot of noise

examples.text: The music is too loud.

senses.definition: not wide; small from one side to the other

examples.text: The streets are very narrow here.

senses.definition: a picture that someone has made with paint

examples.text: There is a big painting above the sofa.

translations.zh: 沙发上方挂着一幅大画。

senses.definition: a person who flies a plane

examples.text: My uncle is a pilot.

senses.definition: a flat round dish that you eat food from

examples.text: Put the plates on the table, please.

senses.definition: not happy; feeling bad about something

examples.text: She was sad when her friend moved away.

senses.definition: a group of words that starts with a capital letter and ends with a full stop

examples.text: Write a sentence with the new word.

translations.zh: 用这个新单词写一个句子。

senses.definition: a piece of clothing for the top of the body, often with buttons and a collar

examples.text: He's wearing a white shirt.

senses.definition: soft white pieces of frozen water that fall from the sky

examples.text: The children played in the snow.

senses.definition: when snow falls from the sky

examples.text: It snowed all night.

senses.definition: a sweet white or brown substance you add to food and drinks

examples.text: Do you take sugar in your tea?

senses.definition: to move through water using your arms and legs

examples.text: Can you swim?
We swam in the lake.

senses.definition: a set of rooms to live in, on one floor of a building

examples.text: They live in an apartment by the sea.

translations.zh: 他们住在海边的一套公寓里。

senses.usageNote: In British English 'flat' is more common; 'apartment' is used more in American English.

senses.definition: not clean

examples.text: Your shoes are dirty.

senses.definition: food cooked in a particular way as part of a meal

examples.text: Dumplings are my favourite dish.

senses.definition: a plate or bowl; 'the dishes' are all the plates and cups to wash

examples.text: I'll wash the dishes.

senses.definition: a test of what you know, usually at school

examples.text: I have a maths exam tomorrow.

senses.usageNote: Say 'take' or 'sit an exam' and 'pass' or 'fail an exam'. 'Pass' means you did well enough, not just 'take part'.

senses.definition: very happy and interested because something good is going to happen

examples.text: The kids are excited about the trip.

translations.zh: 孩子们对这次旅行感到很兴奋。

senses.usageNote: 'Excited' is how you feel; 'exciting' describes the thing that makes you feel it.

senses.definition: what you say when you meet someone or answer the phone

examples.text: Hello, my name is Amy.

senses.definition: wanting or needing food

examples.text: I'm hungry. Let's eat.

senses.definition: to hit something with your foot

examples.text: Kick the ball to me!

senses.definition: a measure of length; 100 centimetres

examples.text: The pool is 25 metres long.

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'metre'; American spelling is 'meter'.

senses.definition: a person who visits a place on holiday

examples.text: The town is full of tourists in summer.

senses.definition: the brother of your mother or father, or your aunt's husband

translations.zh: 叔叔；舅舅；伯伯；姑父；姨父

examples.text: My uncle lives in Canada.

senses.usageNote: English uses one word, 'uncle', for 叔叔, 舅舅, 伯伯, 姑父 and 姨父.

senses.definition: a plant or part of a plant that you eat, such as a carrot or a potato

examples.text: Eat your vegetables!

senses.definition: a round fruit with red, green or yellow skin

examples.text: I eat an apple every day.

senses.definition: a room with a bath or shower, a washbasin and often a toilet

examples.text: The bathroom is upstairs.

senses.definition: a strong shoe that covers your foot and part of your leg

examples.text: Wear your boots, it's raining.

senses.definition: a sweet food made from flour, eggs, sugar and butter

examples.text: Mum made a chocolate cake.

translations.zh: 妈妈做了一个巧克力蛋糕。

senses.definition: a picture made with a pen or pencil

examples.text: What a lovely drawing!

senses.definition: a door or gate where you go into a place

examples.text: Meet me at the main entrance.

senses.definition: to do something or go somewhere quickly because there is not much time

examples.text: Hurry up, the bus is coming!
Sorry, I'm in a hurry.

senses.definition: a short coat

examples.text: Put on your jacket, it's windy.

senses.definition: to close something with a key so it cannot be opened

examples.text: Don't forget to lock the door.

senses.definition: a phone you can carry with you (short for 'mobile phone')

examples.text: Call me on my mobile.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'mobile (phone)'; American English says 'cell phone'.

senses.definition: a person who travels in a car, bus, train or plane but does not drive it

examples.text: The bus had only three passengers.

translations.zh: 公交车上只有三名乘客。

senses.definition: a white substance that makes food taste better

examples.text: This soup needs more salt.

senses.definition: covered with water or another liquid

examples.text: My shoes are wet from the rain.

senses.definition: a round, deep dish for food like soup or rice

examples.text: He ate a bowl of noodles.

senses.definition: a small part of a machine that you press to make it work

examples.text: Press the red button to start.

senses.definition: a small round thing that fastens clothes

examples.text: A button fell off my shirt.

translations.zh: 我衬衫上掉了一颗纽扣。

senses.definition: a sweet brown food made from cocoa

examples.text: Would you like some chocolate?

senses.definition: happy about something

examples.text: I'm pleased to meet you.

senses.definition: small white or brown grains that you cook and eat

examples.text: We have rice with most meals.

translations.zh: 我们大部分饭都配米饭。

senses.usageNote: 'Rice' is uncountable: 'some rice', 'a bowl of rice', not 'rices'.

senses.definition: the season between summer and winter, when leaves fall from trees

examples.text: The leaves turn red in autumn.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'autumn'; American English often says 'fall'.

senses.definition: a solid food made from milk

examples.text: I'd like a cheese sandwich, please.

translations.zh: 我想要一个奶酪三明治。

senses.definition: the activity of making food

examples.text: My hobby is cooking.

senses.definition: the child of your aunt or uncle

translations.zh: 堂兄弟姐妹；表兄弟姐妹

examples.text: My cousin is coming to stay.

senses.usageNote: English uses 'cousin' for all of 堂哥、表姐 and so on, for both boys and girls.

senses.definition: a large, dry area of land with sand and very few plants

examples.text: Camels can live in the desert.

senses.usageNote: Don't mix it up with 'dessert' (sweet food after a meal), which has two s's.

senses.definition: useful, or happy to help people

examples.text: Thanks, that was very helpful.

senses.definition: a person who lives next to you or near you

examples.text: Our neighbour has a big dog.

translations.zh: 我们的邻居有一条大狗。

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'neighbour'; American spelling is 'neighbor'.

senses.definition: a set of steps that go from one level of a building to another

examples.text: Walk up the stairs to the second floor.

senses.definition: one of the hard white things in your mouth that you use to bite

examples.text: My little sister lost a tooth.
Brush your teeth before bed.

senses.definition: very, very good

examples.text: The show was fantastic!

senses.definition: to take something from someone, intending to give it back

examples.text: Can I borrow your pen?

senses.usageNote: You borrow FROM someone; they lend TO you. Mixing these up is one of the most common learner errors.

senses.definition: a large container you fill with water and sit in to wash your body

examples.text: I have a bath every evening.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'have a bath'; 'take a bath' is more American.

senses.definition: a metal object that makes a ringing sound, or a button that makes this sound

examples.text: The school bell rings at nine.

senses.definition: a long strip of leather or cloth worn around the waist

examples.text: He wore a black belt.

senses.definition: to cut into something with your teeth

examples.text: Don't worry, the dog won't bite.

senses.definition: to talk in a friendly, relaxed way

examples.text: We chatted for hours.

senses.definition: a funny film, play or TV show

examples.text: Let's watch a comedy tonight.

senses.definition: the number 11

examples.text: My brother is eleven years old.

senses.definition: a door or way out of a place

examples.text: Where is the nearest exit?

senses.definition: a musical instrument with strings that you play with your fingers

examples.text: My brother plays the guitar.

senses.usageNote: Use 'the' with instruments: 'play the guitar', but not with sports: 'play football'.

senses.definition: a measure of distance; 1,000 metres

examples.text: My school is two kilometres from home.

senses.usageNote: British spelling is 'kilometre'; American spelling is 'kilometer'.

senses.definition: one of the flat green parts that grow on a tree or plant

examples.text: A red leaf fell on my head.

senses.definition: a list of the food you can order in a restaurant

examples.text: Can we see the menu, please?

translations.zh: 请给我们看看菜单好吗？

senses.definition: a piece of glass where you can see yourself

examples.text: She looked in the mirror.

senses.definition: used after the numbers 1 to 12 to give an exact hour

examples.text: School starts at eight o'clock.

senses.usageNote: Use 'o'clock' only for whole hours: 'three o'clock', but 'half past three'.

senses.definition: a thing you use for writing with ink

examples.text: Can I borrow your pen?

translations.zh: 我能借用一下你的笔吗？

senses.definition: to rest and feel calm, with no worries

examples.text: On Sundays I relax at home.

senses.definition: the number 0

examples.text: It was zero degrees this morning.

senses.usageNote: In phone numbers, British speakers often say 'oh' for 0.

senses.definition: to give something to someone for a short time, expecting it back

examples.text: She lent me her bicycle.

senses.definition: sleeping

examples.text: The baby is asleep.

senses.usageNote: 'Asleep' comes after a verb: 'She is asleep', not 'an asleep girl'. Use 'fall asleep' for starting to sleep.

senses.definition: having a pale red colour

examples.text: She has a pink bike.

translations.zh: 她有一辆粉红色的自行车。

senses.definition: in or to another country

examples.text: My uncle works abroad.

senses.usageNote: 'Abroad' is an adverb, so do not use 'to' before it: say 'go abroad', not 'go to abroad'.

senses.definition: a large, strong old building with thick walls and towers

examples.text: We visited an old castle in Scotland.

translations.zh: 我们参观了苏格兰的一座古城堡。

senses.definition: a small flat round piece of metal used as money

examples.text: I found a coin on the floor.

translations.zh: 我在地上捡到一枚硬币。

senses.definition: normal and usual; happening every day

examples.text: Learn English for everyday life.

senses.usageNote: 'Everyday' (one word) comes before a noun: 'everyday clothes'. For 'each day', write two words: 'I read every day'.

senses.definition: things like tables, chairs and beds that you put in a room

examples.text: We bought some new furniture.

senses.usageNote: 'Furniture' is uncountable: say 'a piece of furniture', not 'a furniture' or 'furnitures'.

senses.definition: a building where you keep a car, or a place where cars are repaired

examples.text: Dad parked the car in the garage.

senses.definition: the liquid from fruit or vegetables, used as a drink

examples.text: A glass of orange juice, please.

senses.definition: twelve o'clock at night

examples.text: We stayed up until midnight on New Year's Eve.

translations.zh: 除夕夜我们一直待到午夜。

senses.definition: a small grey or brown animal with a long tail

examples.text: The cat is chasing a mouse.

senses.definition: a small device you move by hand to control a computer

examples.text: Click the mouse twice.

senses.definition: a round vegetable that grows under the ground

examples.text: We had chicken and potatoes for dinner.

translations.zh: 我们晚饭吃了鸡肉和土豆。

senses.definition: a farm animal with thick wool

examples.text: There are many sheep on the hill.

senses.usageNote: The plural is also 'sheep': 'one sheep, ten sheep'.

senses.definition: a flat board on a wall or in a cupboard for putting things on

examples.text: Put the books back on the shelf.

senses.definition: a way of washing your body by standing under running water

examples.text: I have a shower every morning.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'have a shower'; 'take a shower' is also common.

senses.definition: a person who sings, often as a job

examples.text: She wants to be a singer.

senses.definition: to say or write the letters of a word in the correct order

examples.text: How do you spell your name?

senses.definition: the part inside your body where food goes after you eat it

examples.text: My stomach hurts.

senses.definition: a car with a driver that you pay to take you somewhere

examples.text: Let's take a taxi to the airport.

translations.zh: 我们坐出租车去机场吧。

senses.definition: an object for children to play with

examples.text: Please put your toys away.

senses.definition: one of two children born to the same mother at the same time

examples.text: Anna and Lily are twins.

senses.definition: an exciting and unusual experience

examples.text: The book is about a great adventure.

translations.zh: 这本书讲述了一次伟大的冒险。

senses.definition: the father of your father or mother

examples.text: My grandfather likes gardening.

senses.usageNote: English uses one word for both sides of the family. Children often say 'grandpa' or 'grandad'.

senses.definition: a large musical instrument with black and white keys

examples.text: My sister plays the piano.

senses.usageNote: Use 'the' with instruments: 'play the piano', not 'play piano' in careful British English.

senses.definition: a young person between 13 and 19 years old

examples.text: Many teenagers like playing video games.

translations.zh: 很多青少年喜欢玩电子游戏。

senses.definition: a game where two or four players hit a ball over a net with rackets

examples.text: Do you want to play tennis on Saturday?

senses.definition: a building where you go to watch films

examples.text: Let's go to the cinema on Saturday.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'go to the cinema'; American English says 'go to the movies'.

senses.definition: the mother of your father or mother

examples.text: My grandmother makes great dumplings.

translations.zh: 我奶奶包的饺子很好吃。

senses.definition: a very large, grand house where a king or queen lives

examples.text: We visited an old palace in the city.

translations.zh: 我们参观了城里的一座古老宫殿。

senses.definition: very bad or unpleasant

examples.text: The weather was awful yesterday.

senses.definition: a game in which two teams try to throw a ball through a high ring

examples.text: We play basketball after school.

senses.usageNote: Say 'play basketball', with no 'the' before the sport.

senses.definition: not interesting

examples.text: The film was long and boring.

senses.definition: a soft hat with a hard curved part at the front

examples.text: He always wears a baseball cap.

translations.zh: 他总是戴着一顶棒球帽。

senses.definition: a person whose job is to cook in a restaurant

examples.text: The chef made us a special pizza.

translations.zh: 厨师给我们做了一个特别的比萨。

senses.definition: a room in a school where lessons happen

examples.text: Our classroom is on the second floor.

senses.definition: a large farm animal kept for milk or meat

examples.text: The cows are eating grass.

senses.definition: to copy a file, app or music from the internet onto your computer or phone

examples.text: I downloaded a new game.

senses.definition: a piece of cloth with a coloured pattern that stands for a country or group

examples.text: Each team has its own flag.

translations.zh: 每个队都有自己的旗帜。

senses.definition: what you say when you leave someone

examples.text: Say goodbye to Grandma.

senses.definition: a very small animal with six legs, like an ant or a bee

examples.text: A butterfly is a beautiful insect.

translations.zh: 蝴蝶是一种美丽的昆虫。

senses.definition: trousers made of strong blue cotton

examples.text: He's wearing jeans and a T-shirt.

senses.usageNote: 'Jeans' is always plural: 'My jeans are new'. For one, say 'a pair of jeans'.

senses.definition: a large wild cat with yellow-brown fur that lives in Africa

examples.text: We saw a lion at the zoo.

translations.zh: 我们在动物园看到了一头狮子。

senses.definition: a hot liquid food made by cooking vegetables or meat in water

examples.text: Would you like some tomato soup?

senses.usageNote: In English you 'have' or 'eat' soup, not 'drink' soup, when you use a spoon.

senses.definition: a room with a toilet, or the bowl that you sit on to get rid of waste from your body

examples.text: Excuse me, where is the toilet?

senses.definition: not happy; sad

examples.text: She looked unhappy at school today.

translations.zh: 她今天在学校看起来不开心。

senses.definition: a soft yellow food made from milk, put on bread or used in cooking

examples.text: Put some butter on your toast.

senses.definition: the inside surface at the top of a room

examples.text: There is a spider on the ceiling.

senses.definition: a room or building with equipment for doing exercise

examples.text: She goes to the gym every morning.

senses.definition: not interested because nothing is happening

examples.text: I'm bored. Let's go out.

senses.usageNote: 'Bored' is how you feel; 'boring' describes the thing. Say 'I am bored', not 'I am boring' (that means other people find you dull).

senses.definition: to clean or tidy something with a brush

examples.text: Brush your teeth before bed.

senses.definition: a tool with hairs or thin pieces of plastic on a handle, for cleaning, painting or tidying hair

examples.text: I need a bigger brush for this wall.

translations.zh: 刷这面墙我需要一把更大的刷子。

senses.definition: on or to a lower floor of a building

examples.text: Breakfast is ready, come downstairs!

translations.zh: 早餐准备好了，下楼来吧！

senses.definition: afraid

examples.text: The little boy was frightened of the dark.

senses.definition: a small light that you can move around

examples.text: There's a lamp next to my bed.

senses.definition: special clothes that everyone in a group wears, for example at school

examples.text: We wear a uniform at my school.

senses.definition: an animal that you keep at home and look after

examples.text: Do you have any pets?

senses.definition: a website where someone regularly writes about their life or interests

examples.text: She writes a blog about cooking.

translations.zh: 她写一个关于烹饪的博客。

senses.definition: a small restaurant that sells drinks and simple food

examples.text: Let's meet at the cafe.

senses.usageNote: It is also spelt 'café'.

senses.definition: long thin pieces of potato cooked in hot oil

examples.text: We had fish and chips for lunch.

translations.zh: 我们午饭吃了炸鱼薯条。

senses.usageNote: British 'chips' are American 'fries'. Thin crispy ones in a bag are 'crisps' in Britain.

senses.definition: quick at learning and understanding things

examples.text: She's a very clever girl.

translations.zh: 她是个非常聪明的女孩。

senses.definition: a book where you write what happens each day

examples.text: I write in my diary every night.

senses.usageNote: Don't confuse 'diary' with 'dairy' (milk products).

senses.definition: a musical instrument that you hit with sticks or your hands

examples.text: He plays the drums in a band.

senses.definition: a sweet, very cold food made from milk or cream

examples.text: Can I have a chocolate ice cream?

translations.zh: 我能要一个巧克力冰激凌吗？

examples.cloze: Can I have a chocolate {{ice cream}}?

senses.definition: a small computer that you can carry

examples.text: I do my homework on my laptop.

translations.zh: 我用笔记本电脑做作业。

senses.definition: the study of numbers and shapes

examples.text: We have maths every morning.

translations.zh: 我们每天上午都有数学课。

senses.usageNote: British English says 'maths'; American English says 'math'. It takes a singular verb: 'Maths is fun.'

senses.definition: a cold dish of mixed vegetables that are usually not cooked

examples.text: I'd like a chicken salad, please.

senses.definition: a soft round red fruit eaten as a vegetable

examples.text: I put tomatoes in the salad.

translations.zh: 我在沙拉里放了西红柿。

senses.definition: a piece of cloth that hangs over a window

examples.text: Can you close the curtains?

senses.definition: a water bird with a wide flat beak

examples.text: We fed the ducks in the park.

senses.definition: a box-shaped part of a cooker that you use to bake or roast food

examples.text: Put the bread in the oven.

senses.definition: a pink or black farm animal with a flat nose and a short curly tail

examples.text: There are five pigs on the farm.

senses.definition: two pieces of bread with food such as cheese or egg between them

examples.text: I had a cheese sandwich for lunch.

translations.zh: 我午饭吃了一个奶酪三明治。

senses.definition: a substance you use with water to wash your body

examples.text: Wash your hands with soap.

senses.usageNote: 'Soap' is uncountable: 'some soap', 'a bar of soap'.

senses.definition: a very large shop that sells food and things for the home

examples.text: I buy fruit at the supermarket.

senses.definition: on or to a higher floor of a building

examples.text: My bedroom is upstairs.

senses.usageNote: Don't use 'to' before it: 'go upstairs', not 'go to upstairs'.

senses.definition: to cook food like bread or cakes in an oven

examples.text: We baked a cake for Mum.

translations.zh: 我们给妈妈烤了一个蛋糕。

senses.definition: meat from a cow

examples.text: I'd like the beef noodles, please.

senses.definition: a vehicle with two wheels that you ride by pushing pedals

examples.text: I ride my bicycle to school.

senses.definition: a container for rubbish

examples.text: Put the paper in the bin, please.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'bin'; American English often says 'trash can'.

senses.definition: a page or list that shows the days, weeks and months of a year

examples.text: I wrote her birthday on the calendar.

translations.zh: 我把她的生日写在了日历上。

senses.definition: having a very good taste

examples.text: This soup is delicious!

senses.usageNote: 'Delicious' already means 'very tasty', so don't say 'very delicious'; say 'really delicious' or 'absolutely delicious'.

senses.definition: the number 18

examples.text: My cousin is eighteen.

senses.definition: a very large grey animal with big ears and a long nose called a trunk

examples.text: The elephant is drinking water.

senses.definition: a piece of clothing that covers your hand and each finger

examples.text: Wear your gloves, it's cold outside.

senses.definition: school work that you do at home

examples.text: I do my homework after dinner.

senses.usageNote: 'Homework' is uncountable: 'a lot of homework', not 'many homeworks'. Say 'do homework', not 'make homework'.

senses.definition: the set of keys you press to type on a computer, or a musical instrument like a piano

examples.text: My keyboard is missing a key.

senses.definition: a yellow fruit with a sour taste

examples.text: I'd like tea with lemon.

senses.definition: having a colour between red and blue

examples.text: He wore a purple hat.

translations.zh: 他戴了一顶紫色的帽子。

senses.definition: not nice to look at

examples.text: I think that building is ugly.

senses.definition: a small tool with points that you use for eating

examples.text: Can I have a knife and fork?

senses.definition: an official small book you need to travel to other countries

examples.text: Don't forget your passport at the airport.

senses.definition: a round vegetable with a strong smell and taste

examples.text: Cutting an onion makes me cry.

senses.definition: a hot-tasting powder you put on food, often with salt

examples.text: Add a little salt and pepper.

senses.definition: a hollow red, green or yellow vegetable

examples.text: I put a red pepper in the salad.

translations.zh: 我在沙拉里放了一个红甜椒。

senses.definition: a piece of clothing for women or girls that hangs down from the waist

examples.text: She's wearing a blue skirt.

senses.definition: a small amount of food that you eat between meals

examples.text: I have an apple as a snack.

senses.definition: a piece of clothing that covers each leg separately

examples.text: These trousers are too long.

senses.usageNote: 'Trousers' is always plural: 'these trousers are', or 'a pair of trousers'. American English says 'pants'.

senses.definition: a large, warm cover for a bed

examples.text: It's cold. Can I have another blanket?

translations.zh: 好冷，我能再要一条毯子吗？

senses.definition: a film or TV show made with drawings that move

examples.text: The children are watching cartoons.

senses.definition: a book or app that gives the meanings of words

examples.text: Look up the word in your dictionary.

translations.zh: 在词典里查一下这个词。

senses.definition: a toy that looks like a small person or baby

examples.text: My little sister loves her doll.

translations.zh: 我妹妹很喜欢她的洋娃娃。

senses.definition: a paper cover that you put a letter or card in

examples.text: Put the card in the envelope.

senses.definition: a sweet food made from fruit and sugar that you put on bread

examples.text: I like bread with strawberry jam.

senses.definition: a long line of cars that cannot move

examples.text: We were stuck in a traffic jam.

senses.definition: not wanting to work or do anything

examples.text: Our dog is very lazy.

senses.definition: a small animal with long ears and soft fur

examples.text: My rabbit loves carrots.

translations.zh: 我的兔子很爱吃胡萝卜。

senses.definition: bread that has been made brown and hot

examples.text: I had toast and jam for breakfast.

senses.usageNote: 'Toast' is uncountable: 'a piece of toast' or 'some toast', not 'a toast'.

senses.definition: a body temperature that is higher than normal because you are ill

examples.text: The baby has a fever.

senses.usageNote: Say 'have a fever' or 'have a temperature', not 'I am fever'.

senses.definition: a thin wooden thing with a grey centre, used for writing and drawing

examples.text: Write your name in pencil.

senses.definition: things you throw away because you do not want them

examples.text: Please put the rubbish in the bin.

senses.usageNote: British English says 'rubbish'; American English says 'trash' or 'garbage'. It is uncountable.

senses.definition: nervous and not comfortable talking to new people

examples.text: He's shy, but he's very kind.

senses.definition: a tool with a small bowl on a handle, used for eating soup and stirring

examples.text: Can I have a spoon for my soup?

translations.zh: 能给我一把喝汤的勺子吗？

senses.definition: a long curved fruit with yellow skin

examples.text: Monkeys love bananas.

senses.definition: to heat a liquid until it bubbles, or to cook food in very hot water

examples.text: Boil the eggs for five minutes.

senses.definition: a piece of furniture with doors and shelves, for keeping things in

examples.text: The plates are in the cupboard.

senses.usageNote: The 'p' is silent: /ˈkʌbəd/.

senses.definition: the sport or activity of riding a bicycle

examples.text: Cycling is a good way to keep fit.

translations.zh: 骑自行车是保持健康的好方法。

senses.definition: a large box in the kitchen that keeps food cold

examples.text: Put the milk in the fridge.

senses.definition: something you enjoy doing in your free time

examples.text: My hobby is taking photos.

senses.definition: a home that a bird makes for its eggs

examples.text: There's a bird's nest in that tree.

senses.definition: making a lot of noise, or full of noise

examples.text: The classroom is very noisy.

senses.definition: speaking and acting in a kind way that shows respect

examples.text: It's polite to say thank you.

senses.definition: a soft piece of clothing that you wear on your foot inside a shoe

examples.text: I can't find my other sock.

translations.zh: 我找不到另一只袜子了。

senses.definition: a piece of soft cloth you use to dry yourself

examples.text: Don't forget your towel for swimming.

translations.zh: 别忘了带游泳用的毛巾。

senses.definition: a thing you hold over your head to keep dry in the rain

examples.text: Take an umbrella. It might rain.

senses.definition: a place where wild animals are kept so that people can see them

examples.text: We saw lions at the zoo.

translations.zh: 我们在动物园看到了狮子。

senses.definition: a long thin tube of meat that you cook and eat

examples.text: We had sausages and eggs for breakfast.

translations.zh: 我们早餐吃了香肠和鸡蛋。

senses.definition: a long soft seat for two or more people

examples.text: The cat is sleeping on the sofa.

senses.definition: a small flat case for money and cards

examples.text: I left my wallet at home.

senses.definition: a small coloured rubber bag that you fill with air, used at parties

examples.text: We blew up balloons for the party.

senses.definition: having pale yellow hair

examples.text: Her sister has long blonde hair.

translations.zh: 她姐姐有一头金色长发。

senses.definition: a long orange vegetable that grows under the ground

examples.text: Rabbits like to eat carrots.

senses.definition: a person whose job is to look after people's teeth

examples.text: I'm going to the dentist tomorrow.

senses.definition: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal

examples.text: We had ice cream for dessert.

translations.zh: 我们吃了冰淇淋作为甜点。

senses.definition: a pain in your head

examples.text: I have a bad headache.

senses.usageNote: Say 'I have a headache', with 'a'. Not 'My head is ache'.

senses.definition: a line of people waiting for something

examples.text: There was a long queue at the bus stop.

senses.usageNote: British English uses 'queue'; American English says 'line'.

senses.definition: to wait in a line

examples.text: We queued for an hour.

translations.zh: 我们排了一个小时的队。

senses.definition: with a lot of light from the sun

examples.text: It's a sunny day. Let's go out!

translations.zh: 今天阳光明媚，我们出去吧！

senses.definition: all the letters of a language in a fixed order

examples.text: There are 26 letters in the English alphabet.

senses.definition: a meal cooked outside over a fire, or the metal frame you cook on

examples.text: We had a barbecue in the garden.

translations.zh: 我们在花园里搞了一次烧烤。

senses.definition: a small, flat, dry cake that is usually sweet

examples.text: Would you like a chocolate biscuit?

translations.zh: 你想吃块巧克力饼干吗？

senses.usageNote: British 'biscuit' is American 'cookie'.

senses.definition: a flat round piece of meat in a bread roll

examples.text: Can I have a burger and chips?

translations.zh: 我能要一个汉堡和薯条吗？

senses.definition: to cook food in hot oil

examples.text: Mum fried some eggs for breakfast.

translations.zh: 妈妈早饭煎了几个鸡蛋。

senses.definition: a game or short test where people answer questions

examples.text: Our class had a music quiz today.

translations.zh: 我们班今天进行了一场音乐知识竞赛。

senses.definition: a tool with two sharp blades that you use for cutting paper or cloth

examples.text: Can I borrow your scissors?

translations.zh: 我能借用一下你的剪刀吗？

senses.usageNote: 'Scissors' is plural: 'the scissors are here', or 'a pair of scissors'.

senses.definition: a small soft red fruit with tiny seeds on the outside

examples.text: I love strawberries with cream.

senses.definition: a warm piece of clothing with long arms, often made of wool

examples.text: Wear a sweater. It's cold outside.

senses.definition: a meal that you take with you and eat outside

examples.text: Let's have a picnic by the lake.

senses.definition: a large case with a handle for carrying clothes when you travel

examples.text: My suitcase is too heavy.

senses.definition: a vehicle with wings that flies in the sky

examples.text: The aeroplane landed on time.

senses.definition: a shop that sells books

examples.text: There's a nice bookshop near the station.

translations.zh: 车站附近有一家不错的书店。

senses.definition: your family name, which you share with your parents

examples.text: What's your surname?

senses.usageNote: In English the surname usually comes last: in 'Emma Brown', 'Brown' is the surname.

senses.definition: needing or wanting to drink

examples.text: I'm thirsty. Can I have some water?

senses.definition: with everything in the right place

examples.text: Keep your room tidy, please.

senses.definition: to put things back in their places

examples.text: Tidy your desk before you go.

translations.zh: 走之前把你的桌子收拾一下。

senses.definition: with a lot of clouds in the sky

examples.text: It's cloudy but not cold.

senses.definition: a light toy made of paper or cloth that flies in the wind on a long string

examples.text: We flew a kite on the beach.

senses.definition: with a lot of wind

examples.text: It's too windy to fly a kite.

senses.definition: with a lot of rain

examples.text: It was a cold, rainy day.

senses.definition: a thick food made from milk, often with fruit in it

examples.text: I eat yoghurt with fruit for breakfast.

senses.definition: work you do to keep a home clean and tidy

examples.text: Everyone in our family helps with the housework.

translations.zh: 我们家每个人都帮忙做家务。

senses.usageNote: 'Housework' is uncountable and different from 'homework' (school work).

senses.definition: a card with a picture on one side that you send without an envelope

examples.text: She sent me a postcard from Rome.

translations.zh: 她从罗马给我寄了一张明信片。

senses.definition: soft loose clothes that you wear in bed

examples.text: Put your pyjamas on. It's bedtime.
